_note: D&D base items. Inherent effects are rules-as-written properties. Prefix and suffix are applied at load or generation time.
_weapon_authoring_note: Two resolvers read this file. tactical.py (the live dungeon run) needs damage_dice + attack_ability + reach/range_normal/range_long on every hand-slot weapon, or a custom-identity wielder's weapon_attack() raises 'weapon dice are not implemented'. resolution.py (the SIMULATION/rehearsal engine) reads base_damage directly and ignores damage_dice. Keep both populated on every weapon so neither resolver breaks. tags should carry the specific physical subtype (PIERCING/SLASHING/BLUDGEONING) alongside PHYSICAL -- tactical.damage() uses it to pick the armor mitigation lane against divine-plate targets, and items.py's _silhouette() uses it to pick the paperdoll weapon shape. 'axe' has no mechanical tell that distinguishes it from 'sword' (both are ordinarily SLASHING), so an axe-shaped weapon must set an explicit "silhouette": "axe" override -- see items.py's Item.silhouette field. reach is melee reach in feet (5 = adjacent, 10 = a polearm/reach weapon); range_normal/range_long are ranged-attack bands in feet and stay at the reach default for pure melee weapons.

items.name: Doran's Steward's Signet
items.flavor: A dark ring cut with a single bright line. The line is legible only when its bearer is expected.
items.lore: Forged in the foundry of the First Sanctum from dense meteoric iron alloy. The inner band carries micro-inscribed administrative seals that resonate when entering sanctioned precincts.

items.name: Steward's field coat
items.flavor: Layered grey plates over waxed cloth; every buckle has been chosen for quiet use.
items.lore: Tailored from heavy linen dipped in mineral wax, reinforced with overlapping plates of cold-rolled alloy. Designed to turn glancing strikes in dark passageways while deadening the rustle of carried gear.

items.name: Doran's watchblade
items.flavor: A broad, serviceable blade with a nicked guard and a polished edge where a hand keeps finding it.
items.lore: Primeverse steel folded thirty-two times, bearing a deep grey temper that swallows reflections. Its heavy spine acts as a counterweight, delivering the dense concussive impact characteristic of early Steward service.

items.name: tinderbox
items.flavor: Steel, flint, char cloth, and a little wrapped fat. It has been used recently.
items.lore: A compact brass casing containing scorched char cloth, high-purity spark flint, and shaved tallow. Standard issue for expeditions venturing beneath the light of the upper terrace.

items.name: snuff tin
items.flavor: A dented tin of bitter black snuff, sealed against damp.
items.lore: Carved from horn and sealed with bees-wax. Holds ground mint, dried sage, and mild stimulants used by gate sentries to endure twenty-hour watches without losing vigilance.

items.name: Steward's route key
items.flavor: Three teeth, one red thread, and a wax trace on the bow. It is not a general key.
items.lore: An angular, ward-notched key of dull bronze. Its tumblers align with the subterranean locks safeguarding the drainage channels beneath the wellhead.

items.name: longsword
items.flavor: A versatile, double-edged blade favored by martial combatants for its balanced strikes.
items.lore: A standard double-edged arming sword forged according to military specifications. Weighted for both the thrust and the draw cut, balanced three fingers above the crossguard.

items.name: greatsword
items.flavor: A massive, heavy blade designed to sweep through lightly armored foes with wide arcs.
items.lore: A six-foot slab of tempered steel featuring an unsharpened ricasso wrapped in cord. Demands two hands to wield, striking with devastating leverage capable of cleaving pike shafts and light armor.

items.name: silvered dagger
items.flavor: A thin, honed blade, its edge treated with silver -- and light enough to throw.
items.lore: A leaf-bladed fighting knife clad in a microscopic veneer of beaten astral silver. Highly dense and permanently mirror-polished, crafted specifically to bypass the uncanny regeneration of subterranean horrors.

items.name: chain shirt
items.flavor: Interlocking metal rings worn over a padded gambeson, offering solid protection without completely hindering movement.
items.lore: Interlocking rings of mild steel, every rivet hand-hammered over padded wool. Supple enough to wear beneath a common traveler's coat while absorbing slashes from cutlasses and claws.

items.name: ring of protection
items.flavor: A simple silver band that faintly hums with defensive wards. Requires attunement to shield its wearer.
items.lore: A seamless band of dense white electrum inscribed with microscopic geometric glyphs. Projects a persistent harmonic frequency that subtly deflects incoming physical vectors.

items.name: warhammer
items.flavor: A one-handed breaker for armored opposition.
items.lore: A hardened steel square-head paired with a wicked armor-piercing beak. The solid ash haft is bound with steel langets to prevent weapon shearing during heavy concussive impacts.

items.name: glaive
items.flavor: A single-edged blade mounted on a long shaft, perfect for keeping foes at bay.
items.lore: A broad, curved blade riveted securely to a seven-foot treated oak shaft. Combines the sweeping perimeter control of an axe with the standoff reach necessary against mounted or towering opposition.

items.name: rapier
items.flavor: A precise thrusting blade with an ornate guard, favoring agility over raw strength.
items.lore: A slender diamond-section blade housed in a swept hilt of pierced steel. Engineered for blinding thrusts that slip between the articulated seams of enemy harness.

items.name: hand crossbow
items.flavor: A compact, highly mobile crossbow that can easily be fired with one hand.
items.lore: A precision mechanism of tempered spring steel and oiled walnut. Engineered for close-quarters release, easily drawn and fired with a single hand from beneath a cloak.

items.name: battleaxe
items.flavor: A broad-headed martial axe.
items.lore: A broad-bearded wedge of cast iron and forge-welded steel. The pronounced forward hook allows the wielder to catch enemy shields or drag limbs out of defensive alignment.

items.name: hunting bow
items.flavor: A recurve hunting bow, restrung for war.
items.lore: A recurve composite bow of laminated yew and horn. Responsive and resilient, built to loose heavy broadheads through thick brush and damp dungeon air without warping.

items.name: war pick
items.flavor: A narrow spike built to find the seams in plate.
items.lore: A heavy beak of tempered iron angled to concentrate the entirety of a warrior's swing onto a single sharp square millimeter, puncturing plate armor like parchment.

items.name: Ashen Guard helm
items.flavor: Soot-darkened plate with a closed brow.
items.lore: A blackened steel barbute with a narrow visor slit. The inner rim is lined with sheepskin to absorb concussive shock from overhead bludgeons.

items.name: Ashen Guard cuirass
items.flavor: The central, soot-darkened plate of the Ashen Guard set, forged to endure immense heat.
items.lore: Heavy breastplate and backplate forged from low-sulfur slag iron, blackened by oil quenching. Stamped with the watch-mark of the First Garrison.

items.name: Ashen Guard gauntlets
items.flavor: Segmented gloves marked with old fire scars.
items.lore: Articulated hourglass gauntlets with overlapping finger scales. Offers rigid wrist support for parrying without sacrificing grip sensitivity.

items.name: Ashen Guard boots
items.flavor: Heavy boots built for broken stone.
items.lore: Cuffed leather boots reinforced with steel toe-caps and shin splints, treaded for grip on slime-slick dungeon stairwells.

items.name: Wayfarer Scale helm
items.flavor: Layered leather and overlapping scales protecting the crown and jaw.
items.lore: A domed open-faced cap covered in overlapping brass scales, providing skull protection while leaving peripheral sightlines unimpeded.

items.name: Wayfarer Scale coat
items.flavor: A layered scale-mail coat designed for long routes, balancing protection and mobility.
items.lore: A calf-length hauberk of stitched horn and steel scales over boiled leather. Designed for long-range scouts who require mobility across broken terrain.

items.name: Wayfarer Scale gloves
items.flavor: Supple gloves reinforced at the knuckles.
items.lore: Soft calfskin riding gloves faced with light brass studs across the knuckles and outer palm.

items.name: Wayfarer Scale boots
items.flavor: Quiet-soled boots for long routes.
items.lore: Supple leather riding boots equipped with brass arch supports and reinforced heel guards for long marches.

items.name: mace
items.flavor: A flanged iron mace with a leather-wrapped haft.
items.lore: A flanged head of solid cast bronze atop a steel-cored grip. Simple, brutal, and virtually indestructible, requiring no edge maintenance.

items.name: scale mail
items.flavor: Overlapping scales of bronze and steel on a supple leather backing.
items.lore: Overlapping scales of stamped steel riveted onto a leather chassis. Provides formidable coverage against slashing blades and piercing arrows.

items.name: shield
items.flavor: A stout wooden heater shield faced with steel rim and boss.
items.lore: A convex heater shield of layered lime wood faced with raw rawhide and bound in iron. Deflects heavy blows away from the bearer's center of mass.

items.name: holy focus
items.flavor: A carved sunburst medallion blessed for divine spellcasting.
items.lore: A carved solar disc of bleached bone resting upon a bronze chain. Holds an internal resonance that channels divine intent into physical reality.

items.name: signet ring
items.flavor: A signet band stamped with personal or house heraldry.
items.lore: An engraved gold seal carrying an ancestral crest. Recognized by guild factors, bailiffs, and gate wardens as valid proof of identity and authority.

items.name: traveler's cloak
items.flavor: A heavy wool cloak with cowl and bronze clasp.
items.lore: Heavy wool treated with goose fat to shed torrential rains and biting subterranean damp. Generous enough to serve as a blanket at dry camps.

items.name: prayer beads
items.flavor: A strand of carved wooden devotional beads.
items.lore: A loop of ninety polished juniper beads anchored by a small iron hammer pendant. Used to pace devotional breath cycles and maintain focus under pressure.

items.name: herb sachet
items.flavor: A linen sachet of dried aromatic herbs.
items.lore: Dried sprigs of wolfsbane, wild mint, and crushed camphor sewn into waxed silk. Worn near the neck to mask the putrid odor of rot and deter carrion vermin.

items.name: survey lens
items.flavor: A calibrated brass monocle for close inspection.
items.lore: A brass eyepiece housing ground lead-glass lenses of high clarity. Enables the examination of hairline stonework fractures, hidden runes, and lock mechanisms.

items.name: old lantern
items.flavor: A hooded tin lantern that casts clear yellow light.
items.lore: A four-sided tin lantern fitted with mica panes and an adjustable bullseye shutter. Casts a steady amber beam fueled by ordinary whale or seed oil.

items.name: pewter plate
items.flavor: A simple hammered pewter dinner plate, lightly scuffed from cutlery.
items.lore: A sturdy, leaded tableware disc stamped with an artisan's rose mark. Serviceable and difficult to chip or break in transit.

items.name: dining fork
items.flavor: A two-tined dining fork forged from iron.
items.lore: A two-tined dining implement fashioned from beaten brass wire, typical of river-trade settlements.

items.name: carved spoon
items.flavor: A smooth spoon carved from ash wood.
items.lore: A wooden spoon smoothed with walnut oil, whittled from dry alder during long winter evenings.

items.name: table knife
items.flavor: A blunt-point dining knife with wood scales.
items.lore: A blunt-backed utility knife with a bone scale handle, used equally for portioning salted pork and carving kindling.

items.name: ale tankard
items.flavor: A banded wooden tavern tankard.
items.lore: A heavy earthenware mug glazed in forest green, marked with the stamp of the Crooked Crown tavern.

items.name: wine goblet
items.flavor: A pewter drinking goblet with a flared base.
items.lore: A flared bronze vessel with a twisted stem, showing tarnish along the inner rim from years of ceremonial vintages.

items.name: torch
items.flavor: Pitch and linen wrapped around a wooden stave; burns bright for 1 hour.
items.lore: A split hardwood stave soaked in pitch and petroleum residue. Burns for roughly an hour with a crackling, smoky orange flame.

items.name: trail rations
items.flavor: Hardtack wafers and salted cured meat wrapped in wax paper.
items.lore: Hardtack wafers, dried plums, and strips of heavily salted venison sewn into greaseproof parchment.

items.name: canvas backpack
items.flavor: A heavy canvas pack with oiled leather straps and brass buckles.
items.lore: A framed pack of triple-stitched sailcloth fitted with brass grommets and oiled shoulder straps.

items.name: wool bedroll
items.flavor: A heavy wool blanket and waterproof canvas groundcloth rolled tight.
items.lore: A dense fleece blanket backed with oiled canvas, rollable into a tight cylinder lashed beneath a backpack.

items.name: leather coin pouch
items.flavor: A supple pigskin drawstring pouch for holding coins and gems.
items.lore: A deerskin drawstring bag reinforced with double-welt stitching, sized to hold fifty standard silver marks comfortably.

items.name: dagger
items.flavor: A double-edged steel dagger with a plain leather-wrapped grip and a needle point.
items.lore: The quintessential sidearm of the Primeverse. Forged from high-carbon spring steel, balanced identically for swift thrusts from concealment or a desperate close-range throw.

items.name: shortsword
items.flavor: A straight double-edged blade favored by skirmishers and watchmen in close corridors.
items.lore: Manufactured in municipal armories throughout the settlements. Its stiff central ridge ensures clean armor penetration in narrow passages where larger blades would foul against stonework.

items.name: scimitar
items.flavor: A gracefully curved saber with a single keen cutting edge that sings through the air.
items.lore: Brought north along the canal trade routes. The curved belly of the blade maximizes draw-cut contact area, slicing through leather and cloth with minimal arm exertion.

items.name: shortbow
items.flavor: A compact yew stave with oiled sinew backing, quick to bring to bear.
items.lore: Favored by scouts and tunnel outriders who cannot afford the cumbersome length of a great war bow. Snaps arrows with high velocity out to effective skirmishing range.

items.name: longbow
items.flavor: A towering stave of seasoned heartwood yew with horn nocks and a heavy draw.
items.lore: A devastating battlefield instrument requiring immense back and shoulder conditioning. Looses heavy bodkin shafts capable of puncturing plate armor across wide cavern spaces.

items.name: light crossbow
items.flavor: A steel prod mounted on a wooden tiller with an iron stirrup for drawing.
items.lore: The democratic weapon of town militias. Requires minimal athletic training to point and loose, storing mechanical energy in its tempered prod to drive quarrel bolts with steady force.

items.name: heavy crossbow
items.flavor: A massive siege engine scaled for the infantryman, fitted with a heavy cranequin winch.
items.lore: Forged with a laminated steel prod of immense tension. When loosed, its heavy square-headed bolts deliver concussive kinetic energy that shatters bones behind struck shields.

items.name: spear
items.flavor: An ash haft tipped with a leaf-shaped steel point and reinforced iron langets.
items.lore: The most ancient and reliable arm in the Primeverse. Equally lethal held behind a shield in the battle line or hurled across a sunken courtyard into an oncoming threat.

items.name: pike
items.flavor: An imposing twelve-foot ash shaft tipped with a four-sided armor-punching spike.
items.lore: Designed for defensive hedge formations. Its extended reach forces monstrous beasts and cavalry to impale themselves on its spike before their claws or fangs can reach the bearer.

items.name: halberd
items.flavor: A formidable polearm combining an axe blade, a top thrusting spike, and a rear beak hook.
items.lore: The pinnacle of heavy infantry pole-arms. Enables a trained soldier to chop, thrust, or disarm shields with massive mechanical leverage from outside sword reach.

items.name: morningstar
items.flavor: A dense steel ball bristling with pyramidal spikes atop a steel-plated haft.
items.lore: A fearsome anti-armor weapon that blends bludgeoning shock with piercing punctures. Glancing impacts catch on the armor face and drive spikes through plate ridges.

items.name: flail
items.flavor: A spiked iron sphere connected to a hardwood haft by three heavy chain links.
items.lore: The articulated chain makes the weapon impossible to parry traditionally, wrapping over shield rims and around crossguards to strike defenders who believe themselves protected.

items.name: trident
items.flavor: A three-pronged steel fork with barbed tines and an oiled brass grip.
items.lore: Adapted from canal fishing implements for the arena and the wet underways. The outer tines easily catch and twist enemy blades, allowing rapid follow-up thrusts.

items.name: scythe
items.flavor: A crescent blade with a razor inner curve fastened perpendicular to an ash snath.
items.lore: An agricultural tool repurposed for desperate uprisings and grim ritual executions. The sweeping inward draw of its curved edge inflicts catastrophic lacerations.

items.name: quarterstaff
items.flavor: A six-foot length of dense seasoned ash capped at both ends with iron ferrules.
items.lore: Simple, unassuming, and immensely versatile in skilled hands. Delivers rapid alternating blows from either end that disorient attackers while parrying incoming cuts cleanly.

items.name: club
items.flavor: A knotty cudgel of fire-hardened oak with a cord wrist thong.
items.lore: The most primitive weapon of survival. Weighted heavily toward the knot, imparting concussive force capable of cracking ribs and stunning unarmored adversaries.

items.name: arcane wand
items.flavor: A slender baton of petrified rowanwood bound with copper filigree and a crystal tip.
items.lore: Attuned to focus raw arcane force into needle-thin bolts of kinetic disruption. Does not require brute muscle to loose, tracking the mental geometry of the caster.

items.name: elder staff
items.flavor: A gnarled staff of black elderwood that faintly hums with suppressed magical pressure.
items.lore: Harvested from trees growing over sunken conduits of the Old Empire. Its porous wood naturally absorbs and stabilizes volatile mana, allowing prolonged spellcasting without resonance burn.

items.name: padded armor
items.flavor: Quilted layers of heavy cloth and batting stitched in diamond baffles.
items.lore: The humble foundation of all heavy harness, worn alone by river boatmen and laborers. Dampens concussive strikes, though vulnerable to piercing daggers and point thrusts.

items.name: leather armor
items.flavor: Supple cured steerhide reinforced across the shoulders and chest with boiled leather.
items.lore: Treated in brine and bark tannin to retain full flexibility while providing a tough outer barrier against animal claws, knives, and ambient underground grit.

items.name: studded leather armor
items.flavor: Dense dyed leather set with hundreds of close-spaced steel rivets.
items.lore: Each rivet covers a small internal steel plate sandwiched between leather layers. Glancing blades slide off the hardened studs before cutting the hide beneath.

items.name: hide armor
items.flavor: Thick pelts of winter bear and dire wolf cured with heavy grease.
items.lore: Rough-hewn protective wear favored by wilderness stalkers and outriders. Provides reliable insulation against damp subterranean chills at the expense of agility.

items.name: breastplate
items.flavor: A fitted plate of cold-rolled steel protecting the chest and vitals, strapped over leather.
items.lore: The choice of cavalry officers and duelists who require maximum vital protection without the stifling weight or restricted stride of a full harness.

items.name: half plate
items.flavor: Interlocking steel breastplate, rerebraces, greaves, and faulds over a mail hauberk.
items.lore: Comprehensive personal protection covering all primary arterial lines and joints with articulated steel lamellae. Requires considerable strength to march in for hours.

items.name: full plate
utility_uses: render bearer impervious to ordinary arrows
items.flavor: A complete articulated fortress of custom-fitted, polished steel plates.
items.lore: The absolute pinnacle of Primeverse armor craft. Every plate is contoured to deflect incoming kinetic vectors outward, rendering the wearer practically impervious to standard infantry blades.

items.name: brigandine
items.flavor: Heavy velvet and linen sandwiching hundreds of overlapping rectangular steel plates.
items.lore: Favored by mercenary captains who prize elegance alongside resilience. The overlapping plates disperse concussive force across a wide area without the rigid immobility of a solid cuirass.

items.name: warded robe
items.flavor: Flowing silk robes woven with fine silver thread and lined with leaden velvet.
items.lore: Spun on spell-looms from spider-silk saturated with sanctified salts. Though feeling no heavier than common festival garments, it turns steel blades as though they struck stone.

items.name: enchanted cowl
items.flavor: A dark linen hood embroidered along its hem with faint blue defensive runes.
items.lore: Woven by cloistered arcanists to shield their temples during volatile experimentations. Projects a localized dampening field that shields the wearer's neck and head.

items.name: iron greaves
items.flavor: Curved shin-plates of heavy hammered iron secured by triple leather straps.
items.lore: Forged to guard the exposed shins and ankles of frontline infantry from low spear thrusts, traps, and slashing beast claws.

items.name: heavy tower shield
items.flavor: A rectangular door of oak planks bound with heavy iron braces and a viewing slit.
items.lore: Virtually a portable rampart. Grounded in the dirt during incoming barrages, it grants complete physical concealment against projectile fire at the cost of mobility.

items.name: buckler shield
items.flavor: A small circular steel boss gripped firmly in the fist, edged with bronze.
items.lore: Compact and agile, designed not to shelter the body but to aggressively intercept and bind the opponent's sword at the instant of strike.

items.name: vial of healing draught
items.flavor: A stoppered glass phial glowing with faint ruby warmth that tastes of honey and iron.
items.lore: Distilled from mountain ginseng and suspended alchemical silver. When consumed, it accelerates the body's natural coagulation and cellular knit tenfold within seconds.

items.name: vial of restorative nectar
items.flavor: An iridescent golden liquid that smells of pine needles and ozone.
items.lore: An alchemical panacea brewed from solar lilies. Purges biological poisons and neutralizes lingering paralyzing venoms from the bloodstream upon ingestion.

items.name: draught of iron-skin
items.flavor: A thick, slate-grey tonic that settles heavily in the stomach like molten lead.
items.lore: Infused with suspended microscopic basalt particles. Hardens the epidermis to the resilience of petrified wood for the duration of a pitched skirmish.

items.name: draught of swiftness
items.flavor: A quicksilver broth that bubbles vigorously without heat.
items.lore: Stimulates the nervous system with astral static, sharpening reaction time and accelerating sprinting cadence across hazardous terrain.

items.name: flask of liquid fire
items.flavor: A clay amphora sealed with wax containing volatile naphtha and sulfur.
items.lore: A devastating incendiary compound that ignites violently on contact with atmospheric air when the ceramic shell fractures against stone or flesh.

items.name: smoke bomb
items.flavor: A ceramic sphere packed with sulfur, saltpeter, and dried pitch.
items.lore: Ignited by pulling a friction cord. Produces a sudden, choking cloud of opaque grey smoke that blinds archers and disrupts enemy pursuit in close corridors.

items.name: antitoxin vial
items.flavor: A chalky white mixture of activated charcoal and dried viper bile.
items.lore: Essential standard issue for delving into pestilent underways. Absorbs ingested and bloodstream toxins before they can attack the central nervous system.

items.name: amulet of shielding
items.flavor: A polished disc of lapis lazuli encased in a spiraling silver torque.
items.lore: Inscribed with ancient geometry from the Second Era. Projects a microscopic kinetic buffer that reduces the penetration depth of incoming physical strikes.

items.name: talisman of warding
items.flavor: A fossilized ammonite carved with microscopic protective runes.
items.lore: The spiral fossil acts as an arcane dampener, soaking up malignant psychic vibrations and fortifying the bearer's mental resolve under magical pressure.

items.name: band of vigor
items.flavor: A thick band of hammered bloodstone that pulses warmly against the finger.
items.lore: Attuned to the vitality of the wearer's heart. Gently stimulates red marrow production, bolstering stamina and physical durability in hostile environments.

items.name: pendant of clarity
items.flavor: A clear prism of cut rock crystal hanging from a braided silver cord.
items.lore: Refracts ambient magical fields, allowing the wearer to see through magical mirages, phantasms, and subtle visual distortions in deep vaults.

items.name: relic of the sunken gate
items.flavor: A barnacle-crusted bronze cog that stays damp even beside a roaring fire.
items.lore: Salvaged from the submerged lockwork of the ancient sunken floodgates. It pulses with the rhythmic ebb of subterranean tides, whispering forgotten paths beneath the water table.

items.name: ring of embers
items.flavor: A ring of blackened brass set with a smoldering cinder that never turns to ash.
items.lore: Harvested from the magma vents beneath the lower foundations. Channels dangerous ambient heat into harmless infrared radiation, insulating the bearer against scorching burns.

items.name: stone of warming
items.flavor: A smooth river stone that radiates the comforting warmth of a sun-baked rock.
items.lore: Charged under the desert sun before being sealed in damp-proof lead. Emits steady, gentle heat for months on end, serving as a lifesaver in frostbitten ruins.
